description.zh:
队列作业。 

格式X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业。
description.en:
The job array.

Format: X-Y:Z. The minimum index value X is the first index. The maximum index value Y is the last index. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6.

description.zh:
采用异步消息链路提交作业。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous link to submit the job.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
作业最大运行时间，支持三种格式：

- hh:mm:ss
- mm:ss
- ss

推荐使用第一种格式。若最大运行时间为12小时，示例：12:00:00。
description.en:
The maximum running time of the job. Valid formats:

*   hh:mm:ss
*   mm:ss
*   ss

We recommend that you use the hh:mm:ss format. If the maximum running time is 12 hours, set the value to 12:00:00.

description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en: The command that is used to run the job.

description.zh: 执行作业命令。
description.en:
The name of the user that runs the job.

You can call the [ListUsers](~~188572~~) operation to query the users of the cluster.

description.zh: 单个计算节点所需的CPU核数。
description.en: The number of CPU cores required by a single compute node.

description.zh:
单个计算节点使用GPU的数量。

仅支持使用PBS调度器的集群，且集群内计算节点含GPU时该参数生效。
description.en:
The maximum GPU usage required by a single compute node.

The parameter takes effect only when the cluster uses PBS and a compute node is a GPU-accelerated instance.

description.zh: 上传到OSS的作业文件的URL地址。
description.en: The URL of the job file that is uploaded to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

description.zh:
执行作业的队列名称。

您可以通过调用[ListQueues](~~92176~~)获取队列名称。
description.en:
The name of the queue in which the job is run.

You can call the [ListQueues](~~92176~~) operation to query the name of the queue.

description.zh:
任务重试次数，取值范围1~10。当前任务重试功能仅适用于PBS集群。

> 若该参数为空，则参数JobRetry.Priority、JobRetry.OnExitCode不生效。
description.en:
The number of retries for the job. Valid values: 1 to 10. You can only retry jobs that are run on the PBS clusters.

>  If this parameter is left empty, the JobRetry.Priority and JobRetry.OnExitCode parameters do not take effect.

description.zh:
作业重试条件。退出码为参数值时，触发作业重试。

> 若该参数为空，退出码非0时触发作业重试。
description.en:
The retry condition of the job. If the exit code is the value of the parameter, the job retry is triggered.

>  If this parameter is left empty, the job retry is triggered when the exit code is not 0.

description.zh:
重试作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

> 若该参数为空，则重试作业优先级=min{原作业优先级+1, 9}
description.en:
The priority of the job retry. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

>  If this parameter is left empty, the priority of the job retry is min {Priority of the original job +1, 9}.

description.zh: 单个计算节点最大使用内存数，支持GB、MB、KB，单位不区分大小写。
description.en: The maximum memory usage required by a single compute node. Unit: GB, MB, or KB. The unit is case-insensitive.

description.zh: 作业名称。长度为6~30个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含数字、半角句号（.）。
description.en: job1

description.zh:
执行作业所需的计算节点数。

> 若该参数为空，则参数Cpu、Task、Thread、Mem、Gpu不生效。
description.en:
The number of compute nodes required to run the job.

> If the parameter is not specified, the Cpu, Task, Thread, Mem, and Gpu parameters become invalid.

description.zh: 执行作业路径。
description.en: The path that is used to run the job.

description.zh: 提交作业后执行的命令。
description.en: The command to perform on the job after the job is submitted.

description.zh:
作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

默认值：0
description.en:
The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

Default value: 0.

description.zh:
是否支持重新执行作业。取值范围：
- true：支持
- false：不支持
description.en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:

*   true: The job can be rerun.
*   false: The job cannot be rerun.

description.zh:
执行作业的用户名。

您可以通过调用[ListUsers](~~188572~~)获取该集群中的用户名。
description.en: The password that corresponds to the username.

description.zh: 用户密码。
description.en: The name of the job. The name must be 6 to 30 characters in length and start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, and periods (.).

description.zh: 错误输出路径。
description.en: The output file path of stderr.

description.zh: 标准输出路径。
description.en: The output file path of stdout.

description.zh:
单个计算节点创建的进程数。

适用于MPI作业。
description.en:
The number of processes created for a single compute node.

The parameter is applicable to Message Passing Interface (MPI) jobs.

description.zh:
单个计算节点创建的线程数。

适用于OpenMP作业。
description.en:
The number of threads created for a single compute node.

The parameter is applicable to OpenMP jobs.

description.zh:
解压命令。解压OSS下载的文件。取值范围：

- tar xzf：解开gzip格式压缩包

- tar xf：解开tar格式压缩包

- unzip：解开zip格式压缩包
description.en:
The command for file decompression. The command that is used to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. Valid values:

*   tar xzf: Decompresses GZIP files.
*   tar xf: Decompresses TAR files.
*   unzip: Decompresses ZIP files.

description.zh: 执行作业的环境变量，可以在作业执行文件中访问环境变量。
description.en: The runtime variables passed to the job. They can be accessed by using environment variables in the executable file.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
在集群提交作业前，请确认上传作业文件（如job.sh）到集群。具体操作，请参见[CreateJobFile](~~159049~~)。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc submit-job --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command-line ./LammpsTest/lammps.pbs --runas-user testuser --runas-user-password 120000 --name jobtest --priority 0 --package-path ./Tem --stdout-redirect-path ./LammpsTest --stderr-redirect-path ./LammpsTest --re-runable false --array-request 1-10:2 --variables Name:test1,Value:value1_,_Name:test2,Value:value2 --input-file-url https://ehpc-hangzhou.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/test-u40000/testlist_ehpc.sh --unzip-cmd tar_xzf --post-cmd-line example.sh --job-queue workq --node 2 --cpu 2 --task 2 --thread 1 --mem 1GB --gpu 1 --clock-time 12:00:00 --job-retry-count 5 --job-retry-priority 1 --job-retry-on-exit-code 1 --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc SubmitJob --region cn-hangzhou --Task 2 --Node 2 --Cpu 2 --RunasUserPassword 120000 --RunasUser testuser --Gpu 1 --UnzipCmd tar_xzf --Name jobtest --Variables 'Name:test1,Value:value1_,_Name:test2,Value:value2' --PostCmdLine 'example.sh' --InputFileUrl 'https://ehpc-hangzhou.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/test-u40000/testlist_ehpc.sh' --Async false --JobRetry.Priority 1 --JobRetry.OnExitCode 1 --ArrayRequest '1-10:2' --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --JobQueue workq --Priority 0 --StderrRedirectPath './LammpsTest' --JobRetry.Count 5 --ClockTime '12:00:00' --Thread 1 --ReRunable false --CommandLine './LammpsTest/lammps.pbs' --Mem 1GB --StdoutRedirectPath './LammpsTest' --PackagePath './Tem'
